objective: Certificar exclusivamente readiness tecnico-operativo de Cavas sobre Development despues del cierre 100% de Gate13B. No agregar funciones, no modificar codigo, datos, RBAC, menus, infraestructura ni Produccion. Auditar contrato existente, SQL canonico, integridad referencial, ausencia de residuos UAT, dependencias prohibidas Mongo/LIVE, wiring backend/frontend y evidencia de rollback/deployment ya existente en repositorio. Reportar blockers reales sin corregirlos.

queries.name: cavas_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE N'CavaSocios_%' ORDER BY t.name;

queries.name: cavas_fk
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id) AS child_table,name,is_disabled,is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos')) ORDER BY child_table,name;

queries.name: uat_personas
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC LIKE N'UAT13B%';

queries.name: uat_bottles
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas WHERE ProductoNombre LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR ProductoCodigo LIKE N'UAT13B-%';

queries.name: uat_movements
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos WHERE Observaciones LIKE N'UAT13B-%' OR MotivoMovimiento LIKE N'CAVAS-GATE13B-%';

queries.name: canary
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');
